title: Holidays Around the World
text:
Many countries have special holidays. In Mexico, people celebrate the Day of the Dead. Families make small altars with photos and flowers. They eat sweet bread.

In Japan, many people visit temples at New Year. They say prayers and buy lucky charms. Children often get money in small envelopes.

questions.text: What do families make in Mexico?
options: Small altars with photos and flowers

questions.text: What do children often get in Japan?
How do families in Mexico probably feel about the Day of the Dead?
options: They respect and remember people they love
They are angry and want to leave
They are bored and go to sleep
They are at school and do homework

questions.text: Why might people in Japan visit temples at New Year?
options: To ask for good luck in the new year
To buy new shoes for school
To watch a film with friends
To play football in a park

vocabulary.definition: buildings where people go to pray
flat paper covers for letters or money

paragraph_translations: Muchos países tienen fiestas especiales. En México, la gente celebra el Día de los Muertos. Las familias hacen pequeños altares con fotos y flores. Comen pan dulce.
En Japón, mucha gente visita los templos en Año Nuevo. Dicen oraciones y compran amuletos de la suerte. Los niños suelen recibir dinero en pequeños sobres.
